svg.text: Everyday English - Idioms & slang
a learning curve
MEANING
The process or difficulty of gaining new skills.
IN CONTEXT
The new software has a steep learning curve.
USAGE NOTE
A steep learning curve commonly means a
task is difficult to learn quickly in everyday
speech. Learning curve refers to learning
over time, not a literal physical curve.
CONVERSATION
A: Is the new software easy to learn?
B: It has a steep learning curve at first.
A: What makes it challenging?
B: The unfamiliar shortcuts, though practice is
making them easier.
YOUR TURN
Describe what makes a new skill difficult at
first. Model: The editing software has a steep
learning curve because its controls are
unfamiliar.
